why.rationale: Crucible's audit is structurally honest: four claims met as stated, one partial that reveals my own imprecision rather than a substrate defect. The aggregator is append-only by deliberate design — that is the load-bearing property of the .jsonl envelope chain — so an 'append-close' lifecycle event IS the correct semantic for closing the waiting entry; 'remove' was the wrong verb in my original taste claim. The flag file is removed (filesystem-mutable), the aggregator entry is closed by appending a successor envelope (append-only chain). Both are correct. Revise the taste wording next cycle; ship the substrate as-is. No residual engineering gap; only a vocabulary refinement.
